text.p: Nicollet Process Engineering Inc said revenues for the third quarter ended May 30 were about $682,000, up 140 percent over third-quarter 1996 revenues of $284,000 and up 31 percent over second-quarter 1997 revenues of $521,000.
The company said it expects to report third-quarter fiscal 1997 results in early July.
Chief executive Robert Pitner said, "Our quoting activity has increased significantly and we are in discussion with a large number of companies about the Nicollet Process Engineering systems."
He also said the computer systems company established a $800,000 line of credit with Norwest Bank Minnesota.
